neighbor.title: ClipSD is already running
neighbor.text_store: ClipSD is already running (Microsoft Store version). Its icon is next to the clock; if you do not see it, expand the hidden icons with the arrow. A second copy does not start: only one can work at a time. To run the website version, close this one first: right-click the icon, "{quit}".
